pages.title: Onager
pages.text: The onager ($(o)Equus hemionus$()), or Asiatic wild ass, is a wild equid that lives in the deserts and dry steppes of Asia, from Iran and India to Mongolia.$(br2)It is one of the fastest mammals, capable of running at around 64 to 70 kilometres per hour.$(br2)Onagers have a sandy coat with a dark stripe along the back, and they are well adapted to surviving on sparse vegetation in harsh, arid land.
